context.passage:
Digital Tech Conference
May 15 and 16, 10:00 A.M.–5:00 P.M.
Exhibitor Information

Each exhibitor at the Digital Tech Conference will be allowed one booth space measuring 3 meters by 4 meters that includes two tables, four chairs, and access to electrical outlets. Exhibitors are responsible for supplying all other materials they may need.

Conference organizers will assign booth locations. The information will be e-mailed to exhibitors one week before the conference. A map of all exhibitors and their booth locations will be available on the conference Web site and at the conference itself.

Exhibitors may begin setting up their booths at 8:00 A.M. on May 15. All materials should be removed from booths by 7:00 P.M. on May 16.

During the conference, exhibitors must have at least one representative present at their booths at all times.
context.passage_translation:
数字科技大会
5月15日至16日，上午10:00至下午5:00
参展商须知

数字科技大会的每位参展商都可获得一个 3 米乘 4 米的展位，展位内配有两张桌子、四把椅子，并可使用电源插座。参展商须自行提供可能需要的所有其他材料。

大会主办方将分配展位位置。相关信息会在大会开幕前一周通过电子邮件发送给参展商。所有参展商及其展位位置的地图将在大会网站和大会现场提供。

参展商可于 5 月 15 日上午 8:00 开始布置展位。所有材料应在 5 月 16 日下午 7:00 前从展位撤走。

大会期间，参展商必须确保展位始终至少有一名代表在场。
